controls.name: C-7d
controls.query:
FROM logs-system.auth-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= "2026-07-19T10:34:24.500Z" AND @timestamp < "2026-07-19T11:34:24.500Z"
| WHERE user.name == "dev.dana"
        AND source.ip == "172.18.0.11"
        AND event.outcome == "success"
| STATS accepted_count = COUNT(*),
        first_seen = MIN(@timestamp),
        last_seen = MAX(@timestamp)
        BY host.name
| SORT first_seen
